definitions.explanation: The formal rules and regulations established by a school that students must follow. Covers dress code, behavior, hairstyle, and other aspects of student conduct.

examples.japanese: {校則|こうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{校則|こうそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧{校則|こうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧べきだ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: There are calls to review school rules that are out of step with the times.

notes:
USAGE:
{校則|こうそく} combines {校|こう} (school) and {則|そく} (rule). In Japan, school rules have been a topic of debate, with some critics calling overly strict rules ⟦ブラック→ブラック：08787_burakku⟧{校則|こうそく} (unreasonable school rules).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {校則|こうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to follow school rules)
- {校則|こうそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to violate school rules)
- {校則|こうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ (to review school rules)
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{校則|こうそく} (strict school rules)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧ is the general word for rules or regulations in any context. {校則|こうそく} is specifically for school rules.
